description: This file defines a PHP class 'Blog' within the Opencart admin module extension. It manages the admin interface for the Blog module, including displaying configuration settings, saving module data, and handling add/delete operations.

classes.name: Blog
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Blog module in Opencart admin interface, providing methods for viewing, saving, adding, and deleting blog modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the blog module configuration page, loads existing module info if available, and prepares data for the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module configuration settings, including validation and updating or creating module entries.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new blog module entry with default values and permissions check.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a specified blog module based on module_id, after permission validation.
